# Patches

## @expo/metro-config@55.0.21

Pins `lightningcss` from `^1.30.1` to `1.30.1`.

Versions 1.30.2+ have a serde deserialization bug that crashes iOS builds when
processing `var()` references in CSS. Remove this patch once `@expo/metro-config`
upgrades its `lightningcss` dependency to a version where the bug is fixed.
